name: Yorgrim, the Chained Reaper

source.note: The Crooked Moon (Legends of Avantris), appendix A. Numbers are the book's; the words are ours. Block on the facing page (PDF 551). Spell save DC 17 and +9 to hit with spells are computed (Charisma +5, proficiency +4); the book gives no numbers for Etherealness.

traits.name: Ancestral Shame
traits.summary: A creature within 30 ft that speaks Orc and spends an action reading the names carved on the stone on its back deals it 20 Radiant damage.
traits.text: If a creature that can speak Orc, within 30 feet of the reaper, takes an action to read aloud the names carved into the memorial stone on the reaper's back, the reaper takes 20 Radiant damage.

traits.name: Ethereal Sight
traits.summary: Sees 60 ft into the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane.
traits.text: While on the Material Plane the reaper can see 60 feet into the Ethereal Plane.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.summary: Moves through creatures and objects as Difficult Terrain; 5 (1d10) Force if it ends a turn inside one.
traits.text: The reaper passes through creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain, and takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.summary: Three times a day, a failed saving throw becomes a success.
traits.text: When the reaper fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead, 3 times a day.

traits.name: Regional Effects (Lair)
traits.summary: Within a mile of its mausoleum a long rest can cost 5 Hit Point maximum (DC 15 Con save), and mist gives incorporeal Undead Advantage on Stealth.
traits.text: Regional effects, within 1 mile of the mausoleum while the reaper lives and keeps its lair there. Chained Vitality: a creature that isn't a Construct or Undead and finishes a Long Rest there makes a DC 15 Constitution save or its Hit Point maximum drops by 5 (to a minimum of 1). Falling Shroud: thin mist rises, and Undead with Incorporeal Movement have Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. Both end the moment it dies or moves its lair.

traits.name: The Jailer
traits.summary: Once a turn, when an attack roll hits him, a chain shoots at the attacker: DC 15 Str save or Grappled (escape DC 13).
traits.text: Once on each turn, when an attack roll hits him, one of his chains lashes out at the attacker, who must make a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be Grappled (escape DC 13).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.summary: One Balefire Scythe and one Chain, then Chain Slam or Fling.

actions.name: Balefire Scythe
actions.summary: +9, reach 15 ft, 2d8+5 Necrotic; the target starts burning, taking Necrotic instead of Fire from it.

actions.name: Chain
actions.summary: +9, reach 20 ft, 2d10+5 Piercing; a Large or smaller target is Grappled (escape DC 15, one of four chains).

actions.name: Chain Slam
actions.summary: Every creature it has Grappled: DC 17 Con save or 1d8+5 Bludgeoning and Stunned until the start of its next turn; half damage on a success.

actions.name: Fling
actions.summary: Throws a Large or smaller creature it holds to a spot it can see within 30 ft (not in the air): DC 17 Dex save for the thrown creature and everyone where it lands, 2d8 Bludgeoning and Prone; half on a success.

actions.name: Etherealness
actions.summary: Slips onto the Ethereal Plane or back; across the border both sides see it but nothing can touch the other plane.
actions.text: The reaper casts Etherealness with no components, using Charisma. While on the Border Ethereal it is visible on the Material Plane and the reverse, but it can't affect or be affected by anything on the plane it left.

actions.name: Lantern Flare
actions.summary: Legendary only. Each creature it chooses within 20 ft: DC 17 Wis save or Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

options.name: Balefire Scythe
options.summary: One Balefire Scythe attack; not again until its next turn.

options.name: Drift
options.summary: Moves up to half its Speed with no Opportunity Attacks.

options.name: Lantern Flare
options.summary: 20-ft emanation, DC 17 Wis save or Disadvantage on checks and attacks until the end of its next turn.

summary: A hovering, chain-bound orc caretaker turned reaper: a balefire scythe and four grappling chains, slams and flings for the held, and a stone on its back whose names it cannot bear to hear. The Harrowing's tune: Cold Iron at first, Cold Fire once Bloodied.

phases.name: Cold Fire
phases.summary: Azure Defiance: flickers of Yorgrim's azure light pass through him and the mist lashes out. Then his voice joins the chorus, the corrupted beacons burn stronger, and the fallen's effigies glow in their beacon colours.

traits_add.name: Corrupted Beacons
traits_add.summary: The eight braziers burn at DC 15, and ending a turn within 5 ft of one forces the save too.

traits_add.name: Fallen Effigies
traits_add.summary: Five coffins on the platforms hold effigies of the Fallen; a Utilize action within 5 ft of a brazier puts one in, cleansing it and wounding the Reaper (engine hook).

traits_add.name: Devouring Balefire
traits_add.summary: A creature starting its turn within 10 ft of the Reaper makes a DC 15 Constitution save or takes 1d6 necrotic.
